name: Constellation
summary: Comprehensive container & Kubernetes security platform: image scanning, CVE DB, admission, runtime (eBPF + L7 DPI), posture, compliance, network-policy generation. Integrates with Astronomer-Go (analogous to NeuVector + Rancher) and runs standalone. Greenfield Go monorepo + separate constellation-vulndb pipeline.

stack.language: Go (all-Go monorepo; C/C++ reserved for DPI hot path only)
stack.db: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector + pg_trgm; sqlc for type-safe queries; goose migrations; partitioning for findings + events
stack.frontend: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Radix UI + Tailwind + TanStack Query + Zustand + Monaco + xterm (mirror astronomer/frontend)
stack.deployment: K8s operator + ConstellationCluster CRD + Helm chart

cve_db.strategy: aggregator + enrichment service (own); trivy-db wrapper used only as Phase 1 bootstrap
cve_db.delivery: signed OCI artifact (cosign-signed) updated 4x/day; oras pull into airgap; importer service writes to local Postgres

scanner_architecture: multi-engine aggregator + dedupe/glue layer; all engines feed one normalized findings schema with provenance + confidence per source
runtime_architecture: single DaemonSet pod per node combining eBPF programs (syscalls/process/network) + userspace L7 DPI (HTTP, gRPC, DNS, SQL, Kafka) + Falco rules engine
reachability: both static (call-graph for Go, Java, Python initially) AND runtime (eBPF symbol-execution observation confirms findings)

admission.catalog: curated named policies as one-click toggles, layered over engines

tenancy: mirror Astronomer: Org > Cluster > Project (both standalone and integrated)
auth: local users (Argon2id) + OIDC/SAML SP, with or without Astronomer; Astronomer JWKS validation when bundled
audit_log: immutable append-only Postgres + S3 archival + hash chain + cosign-signed frozen manifests

findings.risk_score: composite 0-100: CVSS base + KEV multiplier + EPSS probability + reachability boost + asset criticality (override-able)
findings.provenance: every finding records contributing engines + confidence + raw payload

network_policy: learn observed flows in 14-day window, then auto-generate Cilium NetworkPolicy + Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy + native K8s NetworkPolicy for review and apply
key_features_from_references: Resource & Traffic Map (live force-directed UI; NeuVector parity)
Process baselining + container quarantine + forensics capture (NeuVector parity)
Risk-prioritized deployment dashboard + violation timeline (StackRox parity)
CI/CD integration: constellationctl image-check + GitHub Action + GitLab CI templates
notification_routing: Alertmanager-style routing tree per org (match severity/cluster/labels -> channels; inhibition + grouping + throttling); simple UI + YAML escape hatch
plugin_system: gRPC-pluggable scanners, enrichers, exporters (out-of-process binaries); Go interfaces internally
backup: Postgres logical backup to S3-compatible store (MinIO compatible) + operator-orchestrated blue/green upgrades

scale_targets.large_enterprise: 1K clusters / 100K nodes / 1M images / 1B findings (v2 roadmap; requires ClickHouse + sharded Postgres)

non_functional_requirements.NFR-1: Scale (mid-market): 100 clusters / 10K nodes / 100K images / 100M findings on single Postgres 16 with partitioning
non_functional_requirements.NFR-2: Scale (SaaS small): 10 clusters / 500 nodes / 5K images / 5M findings
non_functional_requirements.NFR-3: Latency: admission p99 < 200ms; findings list p95 < 800ms; risk-score recompute < 5s on 1M-finding org
non_functional_requirements.NFR-4: CVE freshness: signed bundle published within 6h of NVD/OSV/GHSA upstream
non_functional_requirements.NFR-5: Availability: management plane 99.9%; in-cluster agents continue local enforcement during MP outage
non_functional_requirements.NFR-6: Security: mTLS internal; envelope-encrypted secrets; FIPS mode; cosign-signed releases; SBOM for own build
non_functional_requirements.NFR-7: Compliance: SOC 2 Type II posture; hash-chained audit; designed-for-FedRAMP-Moderate
non_functional_requirements.NFR-9: Backup: RPO <= 15 min, RTO <= 1 h via operator-managed logical backups to S3
non_functional_requirements.NFR-10: Airgap: every component deployable with zero outbound internet

Java + Python static reachability engine choice (WALA / Jedi / Pyre vs custom)
